objective: Review and explicitly remove one obsolete denominated monthly category budget through native MCP and terminal consumer.
scope: additive tool registration and handlers in src/index.ts
additive tool roster assertions only if required
semantics: Select exact stored category string, strict month, normalized explicit currency; only one denominated matching budget admitted.
Preview is read-only and includes complete exact saved budget plus digest bound to selector and target object; does not authorize anything by itself.
Commit fresh-loads within unchanged single-process Store.update, validates reviewed exact target and digest, removes exactly its array occurrence, preserving every unrelated current value and order.
A stale, missing, legacy/unassigned, ambiguous, malformed or changed target refuses with no write. Already absent is a refusal, never success speculation.
Unrelated current transaction/budget changes are preserved and do not require rejecting the unchanged selected target.
Full target content equality is current-state protection; identical remove/recreate ABA is not detected. No cross-process locking or authentication claim.

CLI connects only explicit loopback MCP URL; prints complete literal JSON review, requires exact typed REMOVE <digest> confirmation, one commit request, and no mutation retry. Cancel/EOF refuse without commit.
A transport error or ambiguous commit response is unconfirmed, never success; operator must inspect fresh state before any new action.
Only authored private ledger fixtures; no live ledger or installed service changes.
acceptance: exact one removal vs zero-limit persistence
all transactions and unknown fields unchanged
stale selected field or unknown field refuses before write
same target unknown-key order canonical hashing stable
cancel EOF incorrect confirmation zero commit
actual Windows terminal review→confirm→readback and no duplicate request
missing ledger preview creates no file
Store serialization and atomic writer unchanged
